text: Entry Requirements Between the age of 18-25 with a High School Certificate or Diploma. The above applicants must be Non-Chinese citizens in good health with Non-criminal records. These foreigners guarantee to observe Chinese disciplines and laws and obey the university rules and regulations. Do respect Chinese culture and customs during your study at HDU. The applicants' Chinese proficiency is not required for an English-taught program. Still, either New TOEFL (above 80), IELTS (above 5.5), or the related Certificate, will be accepted after providing is confirmed or met the application requirement.
